name: Norrbotten County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the stars strewn on the blue quarters

description: A banner of the county arms, quartered: blue quarters strewn with golden stars bearing a white reindeer, and white quarters bearing a red wild man with a club.
history: Norrbotten County's arms, granted in 1949, quarter the arms of Västerbotten (a white reindeer amid golden stars on blue) and Lappland (a red wild man with a club); the flag is the heraldic banner of those arms.

features.role: arms of Norrbotten: Vasterbotten reindeer and Lappland wild man
